This option controls the number of threads that LLVM will use when compiling your
Increasing this value will use more RAM during compile and may reduce compile
If a complex procedure takes a long time to compile with LLVM, the compiler can report
the issue in the DEBUG CONSOLE for you to consider breaking it up into smaller pieces.
Use this threshold to control that behaviour.
Only procedures that take longer to
compile than this threshold will be reported.

This allows future instances of the IDE to compile your code much quicker,
